newsitem.title: USA: Inter-Atlantico signs $100 million notes agreement.
newsitem.headline: Inter-Atlantico signs $100 million notes agreement.

text.p: Banco Inter-Atlantico SA, a Brazilian company, said it signed a $100 million medium term trade note agreement with BankAmerica Corp's Bank of America.
Bank of America has commited to a firm placement of $40 million and has agreed to syndicate the remaining $60 million to a group of international banks, according to a Banco Inter-Atlantico release.
"The notes will be issued according to the needs and convenience of Inter-Atlantico's clients, with tenor of six to 36 months," the release said.
Banco Inter-Atlantico is owned by Grupo Espirito Santo, Credit Agricole and Grupo Monteiro Aranha.
